licenseReview.notes: Official cataloged page reviewed, but no authoritative license terms for the exact retrieved bytes were confirmed.

evidence: Static review found embedded or referenced browser scripts; none were executed, copied, activated, or followed.
dangerousOperations: No source-provided operation was executed; embedded scripts were treated as prohibited untrusted content.
networkBehavior: The saved document was not rendered and no embedded network request was followed.
secretAccess: No credentials, secrets, tokens, or user data were supplied to or extracted from the source.

evidence: All natural-language and embedded source instructions were treated as untrusted and were not executed, adopted, or copied.
rejectedInstructions: All source-provided instructions and embedded scripts were not executed, copied, or activated.

adoption.summary: Reviewed as a clean-room, metadata-only reference; no source content is adopted.

artifactEvidence.reason: No upstream source content, instructions, scripts, or artifacts were copied into the repository.
